# Vela

> Vela is a browser-based 2D and 3D interior concept planner at https://velastudio.space. The current planner is free. Configured accounts save private plans in Firestore; guest projects, recovery drafts and tracing images remain in the current browser.

## Product and support

- [Home](https://velastudio.space/): Product introduction.
- [About](https://velastudio.space/about): Vela's purpose and current product scope.
- [Features](https://velastudio.space/features): Measured layouts, furniture, schematic 3D views, finishes, tracing references and exports.
- [How it works](https://velastudio.space/how-it-works): The measurement-to-export workflow.
- [Flat templates](https://velastudio.space/templates): Eight furnished concepts, two each for 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK and 4BHK.
- [Pricing](https://velastudio.space/pricing): Current free planner; no paid subscription or checkout.
- [FAQ](https://velastudio.space/faq): Answers about units, files, local storage and product limitations.
- [Contact](https://velastudio.space/contact): Product and privacy help at contact@velastudio.space.

## Planning guides

- [Measuring a room](https://velastudio.space/blog/how-to-measure-a-room-for-a-floor-plan): Survey checklist and dimension conventions.
- [Small living room layouts](https://velastudio.space/blog/small-living-room-furniture-layout): Furniture dimensions, movement and alternatives.
- [BHK flat planning](https://velastudio.space/blog/1bhk-2bhk-3bhk-4bhk-flat-planning): Adapting a concept template to a real property.
- [Upload and trace a plan](https://velastudio.space/blog/upload-a-floor-plan-and-trace-it): Supported files and manual tracing.
- [2D versus 3D](https://velastudio.space/blog/2d-vs-3d-interior-design-planning): Choosing a view for each planning task.
- [Export and backup](https://velastudio.space/blog/export-and-back-up-your-interior-design): JSON, SVG, PNG, CSV and presentations.

- [Privacy](https://velastudio.space/privacy)

## Facts and limits

- Accounts use Firebase Authentication when configured. Signed-in editable plans sync privately through Firestore. Guests and unsynced drafts remain local. Tracing images are excluded from cloud saves.
- Plan dimensions follow wall centre lines. Verify site dimensions and wall thicknesses.
- PNG, JPG, WebP and PDF uploads up to 10 MB are tracing references. Only the first PDF page is used. No automatic room recognition.
- Editable backups use project JSON. Exports also include plan SVG, 3D PNG, furniture CSV and a presentation that can be printed to PDF.
- Models are schematic. Editorial interior images are AI-created inspiration, not Vela renderings.
- Costs are user-entered estimates. Currency changes relabel amounts without conversion; tax, delivery and installation are not automatically included.
- Vela supports concept planning. Qualified professionals must verify construction, safety and local requirements.
